figurative_meaning_en: The father of a house son-in-law (referring to someone overly submissive or eager to please, like a pushover in family dynamics)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তৈরী ছেলের বাপের মতো সব কাজে রাজি হয়ে যায়।
এই লোকটি তৈরী ছেলের বাপ, কখনো প্রতিবাদ করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He agrees to everything like the father of a ready son.
This guy is a real father of a ready son; he never protests.
note: The idiom reflects traditional Bengali views on gender roles and family arrangements where sons are prepared for marriage early.
